name: feature-loop
description: Feature development loop on top of acceptance-gate: brainstorm → contract+evals (Gate 1) → plan → execute → multi-agent verify (machine evals dedupe, 3-judge blind panels, adversarial code review via Workflow orchestration) → evidence + human signoff (Gate 2). Two human stops per feature; T3 adds a plan-review stop. v1.7 adds design-loop-aware guards (no-op unless the feature is a web-UI surface AND design-loop is wired) that make the design sub-track deterministic instead of memory-dependent. v1.12 adds Pareto carry-forward (P1 delta-scoped staleness reverify via per-eval paths, P2 baseline-once per evals-hash, P3 judge-panel memo via inputs-hash) — same trust bar, run-log is the only memo. v1.13 adds the CT-S coverage switch: T2/T3 default-on morphological-scan of the AC space at S1, a required contract Coverage section (hard-gate before Gate 1), and Gate-1 card coverage rendering — skipping requires a visible descope entry. v1.14 adds the S1#7 gap-probe: one-pass clean-context critique of the Gate-1 artifact set, P0 findings never silent, rendered on the card. v1.15 adds zero-token per-run usage measurement: [wf-label:] prompt tags in both workflows + scripts/wf-usage.mjs (parses workflow transcripts, message.id-deduped, into a per-role model/token table appended to _acceptance/<slug>/usage-report.md after every Workflow run). Requires: acceptance-gate plugin ≥ 1.16 (same marketplace) + superpowers plugin. v1.16 wires network truth into the S4 ui agent (optional networkObserved passthrough + copy-verbatim synthesize rule), adds the gap-probe cross-layer cross-check and atomic-pair carry-forward for (cross-layer) criteria. v1.16.1 clarifies that a mobile surface never triggers the design lane (CT1/CT2 are web-only). v1.17 adds S4 scope-triage: every confirmed review finding is classified against the contract (in-contract / out-of-contract / unclassified) by one fresh agent, a high in-contract finding drives REJECT so the machine fixes what the contract already bounds, out-of-contract findings never enter the fix list and go to Gate 2 for the human to decide, triage failure fails toward the human (no finding may drive a REJECT), and two or more findings in files no eval covers raise a widen-or-narrow cluster flag. v1.18 adds cross-feature claim index: gap-probe S1 reads lessons from prior features via claim-scan; v1.18.1 hardens its parser (silent-drop class closed). v1.19 closes the V1-retro B1/B4 nets: S1 must load the consuming repo's standards skill via feature_loop.ui_standards_skill (one visible line when absent), the gap-probe cross-checks platform-fit, the S1-D lane routes every UI feature to the in-harness design-pass skill before Gate 1 (skipping requires a named descope entry), and Gate 1 prints the /goal suggestion from the GOAL-TEMPLATE block embedded in the SKILL itself (drift-pinned to GUIDE — the packaged skill no longer depends on GUIDE at runtime). v1.20 makes every plan or progress summary presented to a human load the human-facing-language reference through the plugin resolver (this package does not ship it, so joining it onto the package root is a dead pointer) and render with PLAN-SUMMARY-TABLE-TEMPLATE — MỌI lần trình, not only the T3 plan-review stop. v1.21: câu về hình trong vòng lặp chép nguyên văn khuôn LOOP-PICTURE-CLAUSE, chọn cách vẽ theo mặt phẳng đang trình. v1.22 adds the one-lane re-pin ritual (REPIN-TEMPLATE marker mold: one fresh machine-lane per re-pin event, N per-slug {"kind":"repin"} run-log lines sharing one run_id, machine-enforced by pre-merge/recheck — missing line, sha mismatch, nonzero suites_exit or missing run-log are VIOLATIONs; old-form sections grandfathered) and fix-round P1 carry (invokedSha stamps every run-log line; scripts/carry-plan.mjs computes the carry matrix with atomic-pair; no sha in history → full rerun, the safe default).
